company.name: Pleo
company.shortDescription: Pleo provides smart payment cards for employees to buy work-related products while giving employers control and oversight over the spending.
company.description:
Behind Pleo is the core belief to make everyone feel valued at work, driven by the mission to revolutionize business spending for forward-thinking teams everywhere - so things like a fun-to-use spend management app that automatically tracks work-related spending & generates expense reports, paired with the powerful tools businesses need to create full visibility and management of every penny spent. 

It was founded in 2015 by Jeppe Rindom and Niccolo Perra and is based in Copenhagen, Hovedstaden, Denmark.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for centralizing, controlling, automating, and analyzing company spending, including card purchases, invoices, reimbursements, recurring payments, and accounting workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Pleo Spend Management Platform

productsAndServices.description: Physical, virtual, temporary, and vendor cards that let employees pay for approved business expenses while administrators set limits, monitor transactions, and freeze cards when needed.
productsAndServices.name: Pleo Smart Company Cards

productsAndServices.description: An automated accounts payable service for capturing, processing, approving, paying, and recording supplier invoices within the company’s spending workflow.
productsAndServices.name: Pleo Accounts Payable and Invoice Management

productsAndServices.description: A service for submitting, reviewing, approving, tracking, and recording employee expenses and other amounts that the business needs to repay.
productsAndServices.name: Pleo Reimbursements
